title: Dumbbell Side Bends
overview: Dumbbell Side Bends are a core-strengthening exercise that targets the obliques, the muscles along the sides of your abdomen.This movement helps improve lateral stability, supports better posture, and can enhance core definition when paired with a balanced training program.In addition to the obliques, dumbbell side bends also engage the quadratus lumborum (lower back) and hip stabilizers, making it a functional movement for overall core balance and strength.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a pair of dumbbells at your side.
Engage your core and keep your chest up.
Slowly bend sideways at the waist toward the dumbbell, lowering it toward your knee.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement.
Contract your obliques to return to the starting position. This is one rep.
Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other.
tips: Use a light to moderate weight to focus on form and avoid straining your lower back.
Move slowly and with control, don’t rush the bend or the return.
Don’t lean forward or backward. The movement should be strictly side-to-side.
Exhale as you return to standing to engage your obliques more effectively.
Avoid overextending. Go just far enough to feel a stretch, not strain.
